{{Quote|Marat V – known to its inhabitants as Skye. Not many people in the Empire have heard of it; it's a ''restricted'' world.|Han Solo to Leia Organa|<ref name="Annual 1" />}}
'''Skye''', designated '''Marat V''' by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], was a terrestrial [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] and the [[Homeworld/Legends|home]] of the [[S'kytri]] people. Remaining isolated from the wider [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]], the world attempted to gain admittance into the [[Council of Neutral Systems/Legends|Council of Neutral Systems]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] but was interrupted by an invasion led by [[Zeta Magnus]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].

==History==
Before developing into a terrestrial planet, ancient Skye was a turbulent world of seismic activity and violent unrest on its surface. Various beasts such as [[mutant]] [[blorgworm]]s, five-headed [[gogitol]]s, blood-sucking beasts roamed the planet's surface and contributed to the chaos before the birth of the [[S'kytri]] people. According to legend, the hero [[Hormaket]] the Vanquisher led the S'kytri in a war against the ground-roaming beasts and imprisoned them within the depths of the [[Entyrmion]]'s subterranean hell. With the conclusion of the primordial warfare, the S'kytri established a primitive civilization and remained independent from other civilizations as much as they could.<ref name="swcw" />

Culture on the planet was divided into three distinct sets of clans: the [[Highland Clans|Highland]] and [[Lowland Clans]] which governed the world, and the outcast [[Outland Clan]]s which were deemed genetically inferior. Consisting of about one third of the planet's population, the Outlanders were castigated for having red or orange skin and banished from the aeries and cities of the green and blue-skinned S'kytri. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the Outland Clans joined forces with the mad [[Geneticist/Legends|geneticist]] [[Zeta Magnus]] in an attempt to destroy the other S'kytri clans. However, Magnus infected all S'kytri with a mind-ravishing plague which drove his loyal servants mad. Feasting on them as others launched suicidal campaigns against the mountain fortresses of their Highland and Lowland cousins, Magnus nearly wiped out the species before being driven offworld by [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], and [[Halagad Ventor]]. In exchange for the antidote to Magnus' plague, the planet's [[Patriarch (Skye)|Patriarch]] and [[Supreme Council of the Highland Clans|Supreme Council]] pledged fealty to the Jedi and vowed to fill any debt that was called.<ref name="swcw" />

Under the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] tyranny, Jedi Skywalker returned to Skye in his new guise as [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]]. Calling on their debt, Vader established an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] puppet government on Skye, headed by the [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Magister of Skye|Majestrix]] of Skye, [[Kharys]]. During this period, the planet was restricted, and anyone who set foot on it without a permit from Kharys was put on trial.

During the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Period]], the population was [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]] in forced labor.<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>

When a group of two-dozen [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] landed on Skye without Kharys' consent, she executed them, all but [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Katya M'Buele]] who escaped the planet. Not long after, in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] and Solo traveled to Skye and confronted Kharys. With the backing of the Supreme Council, Skywalker attacked Kharys in [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|combat]] and defeated her, therefore liberating the planet from the Empire's grip.

==Behind the scenes==
The planet Skye first appeared in the [[1979]] [[Star Wars Annual (1977) 1|first annual issue]] of the [[Star Wars (1977)|''Star Wars'']] [[Star Wars comic books|comic series]] by [[Marvel Comics]].<ref name="Annual 1" /> When creating Skye for the issue, [[Chris Claremont]] enjoyed the freedoms and fun that came with creating a story for ''Star Wars'' in the comic medium.<ref name="Insider 146">{{InsiderCite|146|Authors of the Expanded Universe|Authors of the Expanded Universe: Chris Claremont}}</ref>
